additional_requirements: The binge eating occurs, on average, at least once a week for 3 months

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
examples: Swallowing food without chewing it properly.
Eating continuously and rapidly to the point where it is difficult to breathe.
Eating so urgently that there is no time to taste the food.
Eating at a speed that surprises others.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
examples: Eating until the stomach feels distended to the point of bursting and pain.
Eating so much that it is difficult to even stand up or move.
Continuing to eat until feeling nauseous or like vomiting.
Unable to stop eating even though it is physically uncomfortable and painful.

S053.name: Eating_Without_Hunger
S053.description: Eating large amounts of food when not feeling physically hungry.
examples: Starting to eat a large amount of food again immediately after finishing a meal.
A binge eating episode starting when not hungry at all.
Continuing to eat large amounts despite being full.
Seeking out food even when there are absolutely no physical hunger signals.

S054.name: Eating_Alone_Due_to_Embarrassment
S054.description: Eating alone because of feeling embarrassed by how much one is eating.
examples: Eating only when alone because of fear that others will think strangely of the amount eaten.
Eating secretly after family members have gone to sleep.
Pretending to eat little in front of people, then binging when alone.
Locking the door or eating in a secret place like a car to avoid being seen eating.

symptom.disease_info: Binge-Eating Disorder is characterized by recurrent episodes of eating an objectively large amount of food with a sense of loss of control, commonly accompanied by rapid eating, eating when not hungry, eating until uncomfortably full, and eating alone because of embarrassment. It is distinguished from bulimia nervosa by the absence of regular compensatory behaviors, and its course often involves secrecy, shame, and worsening during periods of stress or disrupted routine.

patient.stressor_event: Taking on a mortgage (for home, business)
patient.stressor: After Ganelle bought a small Boston condo with a mortgage that stretched her carefully managed budget, she began accepting extra museum branding projects and late-night freelance sketch sessions to stay ahead financially. Over the next 10 months, her solitary work routine and budget anxiety gradually shifted from carefully planned dinners to private episodes after midnight in which she consumed much more food than intended, quickly and past comfort, often despite not being physically hungry. Because she lived alone and felt embarrassed by the amount, she kept the pattern hidden until her own expense spreadsheet showed repeated delivery charges clustered around all-night work sessions. She contacted a psychiatrist through her employer’s health plan after realizing the pattern had persisted for months and no longer felt like ordinary stress eating.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
S049.manifestation: What brings me in is that on these late work nights I’ll order what I tell myself is dinner, but it turns into a whole entrée, sides, dessert, and extra snacks from my kitchen, way more than I’d ever eat if someone were sitting across from me.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
S050.manifestation: Once I start, there’s this point where I’m watching myself keep clicking back to the food or opening another package, thinking I should stop, but it feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
S051.manifestation: I eat so fast at my desk that I barely notice the taste, just moving from container to container while Illustrator files are open and then realizing I’ve swallowed most of it in a few minutes.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
S052.manifestation: By the end I’m often so full that my stomach feels tight against my waistband and I have to sit very still on the couch before I can even clean up the takeout bags.

S053.name: Eating_Without_Hunger
S053.description: Eating large amounts of food when not feeling physically hungry.
S053.manifestation: A lot of the time it starts after I already had a normal dinner, when I’m not physically hungry at all but I’m still wandering into the kitchen or ordering delivery while I’m trying to finish a project.

S054.name: Eating_Alone_Due_to_Embarrassment
S054.description: Eating alone because of feeling embarrassed by how much one is eating.
S054.manifestation: I’m careful to eat lightly if I’m with coworkers or friends, but when I’m alone in my condo after midnight I’ll close the blinds and get rid of the delivery containers quickly because I’d be mortified if anyone saw how much there was.

add_requirements.at_least_once_a_week_for_3_months: When I look back at my delivery receipts and calendar, there’s usually at least one night every week where this happens, sometimes more, and that pattern has been there for several months.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about ten months, since shortly after I closed on the condo and started taking on all the extra freelance work.
